sections.heading: ANCIENT ORIGINS
sections.text: Gua sha is a traditional healing technique from Ancient China, with a history of over 2,000 years. It was originally used on the body to stimulate circulation, release tension and support the flow of Qi (vital energy). Over time, it evolved into a refined facial practice to promote health, radiance and longevity.

sections.heading: EVOLUTION TO MODERN BEAUTY
sections.text: Today, facial gua sha is embraced worldwide as a natural, non-invasive way to support skin health, lymphatic drainage, muscle relaxation and a lifted, more radiant appearance.

sections.heading: HIKARU LIFT SCULPT
sections.text: A modern evolution of this ancient practice, the Hikaru Lift Sculpt is designed to work with the body’s anatomy, energy pathways and the power of the four Hikaru crystals.
